title: Tunisian Vegetable Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with roasted Tunisian spices and fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: Tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Tunisian spice blend, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the zucchini, bell peppers, and red onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice blend.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the vegetables are roasting, heat the chickpeas and canned tomatoes in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the vegetables are done, add them to the saucepan with the chickpeas and tomatoes.
Serve the mixture in a bowl and enjoy!
